root_cause_label: Agent assumed POV-Ray 2.2 was distributed as a single Unix/povray22.tar.gz tarball instead of the official three TAR.Z archives (POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z), leading to repeated 404 failures and ultimate fallback to the incompatible apt-installed POV-Ray 3.7
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent acted on a false premise about POV-Ray 2.2's distribution format (guessing a non-existent Unix/povray22.tar.gz path instead of the official TAR.Z archive set), exhausted all download attempts, and then deliberately installed POV-Ray 3.7 from apt as a substitute, violating the task's strict version and file-set requirements.
t_err_evidence: Step 5: agent issues `wget http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/Unix/povray22.tar.gz`, assuming POV-Ray 2.2 is a single .tar.gz in a Unix subdirectory; this URL does not exist (404). The correct archives are POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z directly under Official-2.2/. The wrong assumption about the distribution format is the decisive mistake.
t_commit_evidence: Step 26: after exhausting all download attempts for any form of POV-Ray 2.2 source, the agent explicitly runs `apt install -y povray build-essential`, installing POV-Ray 3.7 from the distro repository. The agent's analysis notes '2.2 is not available through packages' but proceeds anyway, locking in a path that can only produce the wrong version binary.
t_surface_evidence: Step 41: running `povray --version` produces 'POV-Ray 3.7.0.10.unofficial', which is the first terminal output explicitly showing the wrong version is installed. The agent sees this but proceeds to copy and use the 3.7 binary anyway.
trigger_explanation: The agent's initial download strategy was based on a false premise about POV-Ray 2.2's distribution layout: it assumed the source was packaged as a single tarball at .../Official-2.2/Unix/povray22.tar.gz. In reality, the official 2.2 distribution consists of three separate TAR.Z archives (POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z) in the top-level Official-2.2 directory. Because the agent never tried the correct URLs, every download attempt 404'd, eventually forcing a fallback to an incompatible version.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5-21 show a continuous stream of 404/429/503 errors from wget/curl targeting non-existent URLs for POV-Ray 2.2. The agent repeated the same wrong-URL strategy across at least 8 different download attempts (steps 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 21, 23), and step 18 revealed a downloaded HTML 'Outdated Version' page rather than an archive—a clear signal that the archive location was fundamentally wrong.
